evidence-6d92c089eb72.sql: SELECT i.order_id, i.id AS item_id, i.quantity, r.id AS return_id, r.status AS return_status, r.quantity AS return_quantity, f.id AS refund_id, f.status AS refund_status, f.amount AS refund_amount_paise, a.gross AS gross_paise, a.refunded AS refunded_paise, a.fee AS fee_paise, p.id AS payout_id, p.status AS payout_status, p.amount AS payout_amount_paise FROM analytics.order_items AS i LEFT JOIN analytics.returns AS r ON r.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN analytics.refunds AS f ON f.return_id = r.id LEFT JOIN analytics.allocations AS a ON a.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN analytics.payouts AS p ON p.allocation_id = a.id WHERE i.order_id = %(order_id)s ORDER BY i.id, r.id

evidence-51b5047a1904.purpose: Recorded order event timeline, including failed and successful attempts
evidence-51b5047a1904.sql: WITH items AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.order_items WHERE order_id = %(order_id)s), return_ids AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.returns WHERE item_id IN (SELECT id FROM items)), allocation_ids AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.allocations WHERE item_id IN (SELECT id FROM items)), related AS (SELECT id FROM analytics.orders WHERE id = %(order_id)s UNION SELECT id FROM items UNION SELECT id FROM return_ids UNION SELECT id FROM allocation_ids UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.refunds WHERE return_id IN (SELECT id FROM return_ids) UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.payouts WHERE allocation_id IN (SELECT id FROM allocation_ids) UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.shipments WHERE item_id IN (SELECT id FROM items) UNION SELECT id FROM analytics.payments WHERE order_id = %(order_id)s) SELECT e.revision, e.kind, e.entity_id, e.details, e.occurred_at, e.recorded_at FROM analytics.events AS e WHERE e.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM related) OR e.details ->> 'id' IN (SELECT id FROM related) ORDER BY e.revision, e.recorded_at, e.id
